faces.name: Incendiary
faces.oracleText:
Enchant creature
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a fuse counter on this Aura.
When enchanted creature dies, this Aura deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of fuse counters on this Aura.

faces.name: Incendiary Command
faces.oracleText:
Choose two —
• Incendiary Command deals 4 damage to target player or planeswalker.
• Incendiary Command deals 2 damage to each creature.
• Destroy target nonbasic land.
• Each player discards all the cards in their hand, then draws that many cards.

faces.name: Incendiary Dissent
faces.oracleText:
Hidden agenda (Start the game with this conspiracy face down in the command zone and secretly choose a card name. You may turn this conspiracy face up any time and reveal that name.)
Creatures you control with the chosen name have "{R}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn."

faces.name: Incendiary Flow
faces.oracleText: Incendiary Flow deals 3 damage to any target. If a creature dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.

faces.name: Incendiary Oracle
faces.oracleText:
{1}{R}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
If a creature dealt damage by this creature this turn would die, exile it instead.

faces.name: Incendiary Sabotage
faces.oracleText:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact.
Incendiary Sabotage deals 3 damage to each creature.

faces.name: Incessant Provocation
faces.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. It perpetually gains "This creature attacks each combat if able."
